turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Prairie Link Broadband · check-in · October 15, 2026

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: **Attendees:** [PERSON_1] (Director of Digital), [PERSON_2] (Web Development Lead), [PERSON_3] (Invoca CSM)

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Summary

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: We did a light check-in on the new single-page app order flow and how call tracking is behaving since the September relaunch. [PERSON_2] walked through what the web team is seeing, and [PERSON_1] asked what the agency needs in order to view campaign performance. [PERSON_3] was clear that the agency sharing question is not something he can confirm and he will look into it.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Discussion

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Prairie Link is running fiber expansion across five states, and this quarter is mostly about keeping the new order flow steady while the agency ramps on paid search.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Call volumes are running at the usual level for this time of the season, roughly 1,900 to 2,100 calls a month across tracked campaigns.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Most of those calls are still Google Ads driven, with Marketo picking up the rest from web form and nurture activity.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: The AI Voice Agent continues to take the outage calls and route people through the usual flow. [PERSON_1] says that piece is fine.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] mentioned the web team is on a two-week sprint cadence and deploying to production on Tuesdays, which matters for any tag changes.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] brought up the agency review. They are presenting a monthly performance read the first week of November and want the agency to pull numbers on their own.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] has two developers who can run a test page or a staging build on short notice if Invoca needs to see the behavior in context.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] asked whether any other tracking has moved in the same window. [PERSON_2] said no, only the order flow changed in September.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Product feedback

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Since the September relaunch of the order flow as a single-page app, DNI only swaps the number on the first page load; after that every visitor sees the default number.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_1] asked whether the campaign dashboard can be shared as a read-only link with their agency, without creating a user seat.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Risks

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: If DNI is not swapping after the first page load, new order-flow visitors are reaching the default number, which makes campaign attribution on those calls unreliable heading into the agency's November read.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: Next steps

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to open a case with the DNI team on the single-page app behavior and confirm whether a staging URL is helpful before the next sprint. Owner: [PERSON_3], by October 16.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to check internally on whether the campaign dashboard offers a read-only share option and what the agency would need on their side. Owner: [PERSON_3], by October 20.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_2] to send the staging URL and a sample of test sessions from the new order flow once the sprint closes. Owner: [PERSON_2], by October 23.

turns.speaker: Notes
turns.text: [PERSON_3] to reconvene with [PERSON_1] and [PERSON_2] the last week of October so there is runway before the agency's first-week-of-November review. Owner: [PERSON_3], by October 27.
